summary: Dashboard redesign testing complete. All backend APIs (12/12 tests) and frontend UI elements verified working correctly. The redesigned dashboard matches the reference design with stat cards, Recharts AreaChart/PieChart, financial summary widget, and improved events table.

issues: Console warnings about chart dimensions (-1 width/height) during initial render - does not affect functionality but indicates Recharts ResponsiveContainer may need explicit dimensions

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Recharts ResponsiveContainer shows console warnings about negative dimensions during initial render. Consider adding explicit minWidth/minHeight to chart containers to suppress warnings.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard redesign fully tested. Admin dashboard shows: 4 stat cards (Total Socios, Socios Ativos, Quotas Pendentes, Receita Anual with change indicator), AreaChart for monthly financial evolution, PieChart for expense distribution, clickable finance summary widget that navigates to /financeiro, events table with 4 columns (Evento, Data, Local, Hora), and Votacoes Abertas section. Regular socio dashboard correctly hides admin-only elements (stat cards, charts, finance widget) and shows only invoices, polls, events, and notifications.
